metadata.article_title: Agent’s authority may be expressed or implied.

article.title: Agent’s authority may be expressed or implied.
article.content: The authority of an agent may be expressed or implied1.
article.html:
186Agent’s authority may be expressed or implied.

Section 186 · Chapter X · Appointment and authority of agents · page 43 of the Act

The authority of an agent may be expressed or implied1.

1 See, however, the Registration Act, 1908 (16 of 1908), s. 33; see also the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908), Sch. I, Order III, rule 4.
